objects.name: Door (base Blueprint)
notes: No health value and no damage-table row for this door is in the exported data. A door is a BHDestruction building (class AWDDoor, one chunk) that opens and swings; players breach it by sprinting, melee, explosives or vehicles, and the Halligan tool spends durability per breach (see the equipment data). A door Blueprint that does not set a value keeps the native default of the AWDDoor class, which is not in the exports.
Closed position: the definition's chunk transform places the mesh (pivot at the hinge). The interaction trigger box (not drawn) sits at Y -80, Z 150 cm.

objects.name: Smashable window (master template)
facts: Glass shards in the break effect
notes: A smashable window has no health value and no damage-table row in the exported data. The class has Normal, Damaged and Smashed states and reacts to a hit on its mesh (an OnWindowMeshHit event with the impact impulse); the master Blueprint sets movement break thresholds, the only numbers stored.
The glass mesh's collision profile is BlockAll. Broken-remains pieces (4 components) are effects and are not drawn.

objects.name: Drone projectile (STN_05)
facts: root box component, 93.2862 x 92 x 37.5432 cm
notes: The health is the Blueprint's WDVitality component (base and max 50). The Blueprint has no damage-entity component, so no per-caliber damage row applies to the drone itself. The explosion shown is its warhead (DA_Drone_ProjectileData).

Only the root box is a collision component with a size in the Blueprint. The skeletal mesh SK_Drone_01 (scale 0.7, under the NetworkSmoothingComponent), the rotor, trail and first-person meshes are visual; the VFX meshes set the NoCollision profile.
